review_comment: The hardlink fallback mechanism reads arbitrary files using untrusted header.linkname from tar archives without path validation. When hardlink creation fails with EPERM, the code resolves header.linkname against cwd and reads the resulting file, enabling directory traversal attacks. Validate header.linkname to ensure it doesn't contain path traversal sequences before using it in path resolution.

The code resolves header.linkname from untrusted tar archives relative to cwd without validating that the resulting path remains within the intended extraction directory. This allows path traversal sequences like '../' to access files outside the restricted area. Validate that the resolved srcpath remains within the intended directory boundaries before using it for filesystem operations.

The added hard link creation uses path.resolve() with untrusted header.linkname from tar archives, which could allow path traversal outside the extraction directory. Validate header.linkname to ensure it doesn't contain '../' sequences or absolute paths before resolution. Implement path containment checks to restrict links to within the extraction directory.
